title: Senior Brand & Communications Manager (m/w/d)
description: Overview PR kann heute mehr, als nur Sichtbarkeit verwalten. Bei getpress bauen wir an einer Marke, die zeigt, wie moderne Kommunikation für Europas ambitionierteste Unternehmen aussehen kann: strategisch, messbar, relevant und mit einem klaren Gefühl für Qualität. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die unsere externe Kommunikation ownt und vor allem sichtbar macht. Jemanden, der*die starke Themen erkennt, gute Formate daraus entwickelt und sie auch selbst umsetzt – von LinkedIn und Website über Podcast, Blog und Whitepaper bis zu Speaker- und Event-Content. Deine Rolle Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Brand, Content, Thought Leadership und externer Kommunikation. Dabei bist du strategisch genug, um Themen, Kanäle und Formate kritisch zu hinterfragen und hands-on genug, um auch selbst zu schreiben, zu produzieren, zu redigieren und Dinge live zu bringen. Du planst, steuerst und produzierst unseren Content für alle relevanten Kanäle und Formate – darunter LinkedIn, Website, Blog, Podcast, Whitepaper sowie Speaker-Auftritte und Events. Du schreibst, redigierst und schärfst Inhalte selbst – von LinkedIn-Posts und Website-Texten über Case Studies und Blogartikel bis zu Podcast-Beschreibungen, Speaker-Profilen und Präsentationsinhalten. Du denkst Visuals, Präsentationen, Social Assets und einfache Foto-/Video-Formate mit und kannst kleinere Content-Produktionen selbst umsetzen oder sauber briefen. Du sparrst mit unseren Corporate Creator*innen und dem C-Level zu Personal Brands, Thought Leadership, Themen, Tonalität und Formatideen. Du betreust unseren Podcast redaktionell von Gäste-Recherche und Briefings bis zur Veröffentlichung und begleitenden Kommunikation. Du sorgst dafür, dass getpress über alle Touchpoints hinweg konsistent, hochwertig und markant auftritt, in Sprache, Look, Dramaturgie und Qualität. Du beobachtest, wie unsere Inhalte performen, leitest daraus Learnings ab und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Formate, Kanäle und Botschaften weiterentwickeln. Du repräsentierst getpress auch nach außen – auf Events, in Netzwerken und an den Stellen, an denen Marke durch echten Kontakt entsteht. Wer du bist Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Kommunikation, Brand, Content oder PR, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld und in einer Agentur oder einem dienstleistungsnahen Kontext. Außerdem macht dich folgendes aus: Ein feines Gespür für Sprache, Tonalität und Qualität. Du erkennst schnell, wann ein Text, Auftritt oder Format wirklich sitzt. Du denkst strategisch mit, verlierst dich aber nicht in Konzepten. Dein Ziel ist Sichtbarkeit schaffen. Du hast LinkedIn, Organic Social und Personal Branding vollständig durchdrungen und weißt, wie man echte Markenwirkung erzeugt. Du kannst Themen priorisieren, Kommunikationsmaßnahmen einschätzen und Redaktionspläne eigenständig strukturieren. Ein gutes Auge für Design, Ästhetik und Brand Consistency, auch bei Slides, Social Assets, Website-Elementen und Event-Content. Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie Canva und hast keine Berührungsängste mit Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe Lightroom oder einfachen Editing-Workflows. Du bringst Foto- und Video-Basics mit oder hast Lust, dich in einfache Inhouse-Content-Produktion einzuarbeiten. Du arbeitest souverän mit KI-Tools und nutzt sie für bessere Recherche, Briefings, Struktur, Workflows, Varianten und Qualität, nicht als Abkürzung für generischen Content. Du hast eine eigene Meinung, gibst klares Feedback und bringst dich im Sparring mit Team und C-Level aktiv ein, statt Aufträge nur abzuarbeiten. Was dich erwartet Volle Ownership: Du bist bei uns die einzige Person in dieser Rolle und gestaltest Brand und Content ohne Doppelstrukturen, mit direktem Draht zum C-Level. Eine Rolle, in der du strategisch gestaltest und selbst umsetzt, und direkt siehst, welche Wirkung deine Arbeit hat. Ein Umfeld, in dem Kommunikation als echter Faktor für Sichtbarkeit, Vertrauen und Relevanz gesehen wird. Die Möglichkeit, neue Tools, Formate und Arbeitsweisen auszuprobieren – besonders an der Schnittstelle von Brand, Content und AI. Ein Team, das ambitioniert, warm und beweglich ist und richtig Bock hat, Dinge voranzubringen. Du wirst regelmäßig vor Ort in Berlin gebraucht – für Abstimmungen, Content-Produktion, Events und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit zentralen Stakeholdern. Gleichzeitig kannst du auch remote arbeiten. Wir setzen auf flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, klarer Kommunikation und Vertrauen. Gehalt: 60.000–70.000 € brutto jährlich Wie gehts weiter? Wenn sich das nach deinem nächsten Schritt anfühlt, dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil, relevante Arbeitsproben oder ein Portfolio . Uns interessiert nicht nur, was du gemacht hast. Sondern vor allem auch, wie du denkst, wie du Qualität einschätzt und welches Gefühl du für starke Kommunikation mitbringst. title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Anthropic (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p>Artefact is a data and AI services company with around 2,500 people across 36 offices. We are part of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network and have rolled out Claude across our own organization, so our advice to clients comes from running it ourselves first.</p> <p>DeployCo is Artefact's team dedicated to deploying Claude at scale inside enterprises. It works through three levers. Deployment and adoption gets organizations from a few early adopters to company-wide use. Process reimagination redesigns core workflows around agentic AI. Agent production ships working agents into client systems. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders behind the third lever and the technical backbone of the other two.</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>As an FDE you join a client's own AI or engineering team as a builder, not an advisor. You design, code, and ship production-grade Claude solutions directly inside their stack, following their conventions, repositories, and CI. You also leave the capability behind, so that when the engagement ends the client's engineers can extend and maintain what was built without us.<br>The work ranges from short, intense engagements, like standing up a governed Claude Code deployment in a few weeks, to longer embeds where you become the technical anchor of a multi-agent portfolio and a larger Artefact pod grows around you. This is a senior role, and we expect you to own technical direction on an engagement from the first week.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build production agents. Design and deploy Claude-based agents and workflows that run in production, with the engineering standards that implies. That means tests, error handling, monitoring, and cost control.</li> <li>Connect Claude to enterprise systems. Build custom MCP servers and connectors to business applications and data sources, enforcing the client's own access rules. This includes permissions, traceability, and segregation of rights.</li> <li>Engineer the context layer. Contribute to Artefact's context platform approach, including deterministic authentication before data reaches the model, user-level context injection, and observability for token spend and security.</li> <li>Deploy and govern Claude Code. Set up SSO and role-based access, managed settings, approved MCP servers and plugin marketplaces, permission modes, sandboxing, and OpenTelemetry-based usage monitoring. Help clients choose between deployment options (Team, Enterprise, cloud providers, gateways) based on security, data residency, and cost.</li> <li>Build reusable skills. Turn client workflows into Claude Skills and shared skills libraries that teams can find, reuse, and build on.</li> <li>Enable client engineers. Pair program, review code, document patterns, and deliver hands-on Claude Code training and labs, sometimes to cohorts of dozens of developers and sometimes to CTOs and engineering leaders.</li> <li>Feed the product loop. Capture deployment pitfalls and product feedback from the field and share it with Anthropic through our partnership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Senior-level experience in software engineering or data science, with production systems you have shipped and operated</li> <li>Recent, hands-on work with the GenAI stack, going beyond prototypes. This includes tool use, agent design, retrieval, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.</li> <li>Demonstrated depth with Claude in particular, such as Claude Code, the Claude API, Skills, or MCP, and a point of view on how the stack is evolving</li> <li>Strong Python or TypeScript, and solid grounding in enterprise integration, including APIs, identity and access management (SSO, OAuth, SCIM), and cloud platforms</li> <li>Confidence in client-facing settings, explaining technical trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders, and running a workshop when needed</li> <li>Fluent in German and English&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Anthropic certification (Claude Certified Developer or Architect) is welcome but not expected, since it is usually only available through a partner company. We support you in earning it once you join.</li> <li>Experience building and securing MCP servers</li> <li>Background in security, observability (OpenTelemetry), or FinOps for AI workloads</li> <li>Experience in regulated industries such as banking, asset management, or pharma</li> <li>A track record of teaching or technical training</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct work with Anthropic's partner and applied AI teams, including co-delivered labs</li> <li>Varied, high-impact engagements across EMEA in finance, retail, industry, and consumer goods</li> <li>A clear path from FDE to technical anchor of a full AI delivery pod</li> <li>Certification support and dedicated learning time</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div><strong>Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! </strong>At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.</div> <div><strong>Diversity &amp; Inclusion at Artefact </strong>&gt; We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are!</div> <div><strong>Ready to take the next step? </strong>Please submit your CV showcasing your experience and passion for this role as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Anthropic (m/f/d). We look forward to receiving your application!</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <p><em>If you have any questions, feel free to send us a message at ----- Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <h2><strong>Job Details</strong></h2> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="5"><strong>Location:</strong> Warsaw, Berlin or Vienna</li> <li data-path-to-node="5"><strong>Stack:</strong> Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, Helm, Kyverno/OPA, GitHub Actions, Cloud IAM</li> <li data-path-to-node="5"><strong>Contract:</strong> B2B (Poland), Full-Time (Vienna or Berlin)</li> </ul> <h2>🚀&nbsp;<strong>Join fiskaly! Help Us Build Trust in Compliance &amp; Security</strong></h2> <p>Our squads ship fast, with AI-assisted tooling, on a regulated fiscalization platform that customers trust with their compliance. We want security to keep pace with that speed, not stand in front of it. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer (Application &amp; Platform Security) to be our founding security engineer in a company of about 150 people. This is a builder's role: you will write the controls that make the secure path the fast path, then prove they work.</p> <h2>💼&nbsp;<strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p data-path-to-node="10">As a Senior individual contributor, you will own the secure baseline for cloud, Kubernetes and application delivery, and you will express it as code rather than documents. You will bring threat modelling into squad design reviews, buy and steer external testing, and act as our named security incident commander. You will work closely with Compliance by supplying the technical facts they need, while the regulatory relationship stays with them. You will have read access to all repositories and staging environments, with break-glass production access under audit. title: Geschäftsleiter Markt - SumUp Bank (Managing Director, Front Office)
description: SumUp is preparing to build a CRR (Capital Requirements Regulation) licensed bank in Germany—an important next chapter in our journey to help small businesses thrive. As Managing Director, Front Office, you'll be part of the team that shapes how this bank serves customers: the proposition we bring to market, the products we build, and the standards by which we grow. This is a rare opportunity to take an executive management role in a new, digitally native bank. You'll combine commercial leadership with direct accountability for customer-facing governance, and represent the market perspective in dialogue with supervisors. We're looking for a leader who sees customer trust and sustainable growth as inseparable—and who can build with the pace of a technology company and the discipline of a bank. What you'll do Together with the other members of the executive management team contribute to the strategic and corporate development of the bank. Lead the market facing part for the German banking licence application. Represent the bank in supervisory dialogue on commercial strategy, products, distribution and customer treatment, including with BaFin, Deutsche Bundesbank and the European Central Bank where relevant. Support building  the go to market operating model and ensure it is integrated into the bank's governance, risk and control framework. Work closely with the Managing Director, Back Office (Geschäftsleiter Marktfolge) to ensure product, conduct and outsourcing risks are understood and managed. Partner with the wider SumUp and bank leadership teams—including Finance, Global Banking, Product and Engineering—to turn the strategy into a viable, well-governed business. Coach the next generation of SumUp leaders on their path to a §25c Abs 1 KWG qualification. You'll be great for this role if… You bring 15 - 20+ years of senior leadership experience in credit institutions, including the qualification according to §25c Abs. 1 KWG. You have led commercial, product or customer activity in a regulated bank and can show how you balanced business performance with customer outcomes, conduct requirements and effective controls. You have a practical understanding of German and European banking regulation, including the requirements relevant to governance, product oversight, market conduct and customer protection. You're fluent in German and have excellent English skills. You can engage credibly with supervisors, communicate complex issues clearly and raise difficult topics early. You bring sound judgement, integrity and the independence of mind expected of a bank executive, and can meet the applicable fitness and propriety requirements for the appointment. You're comfortable building in a fast-moving environment where there may be limited precedent. You can establish the right foundations without slowing the business down with unnecessary processes. Experience in merchant or SME banking, payments, lending, embedded finance, digital banking or API-led products would be especially valuable. So would experience building a new regulated entity or scaling a fintech, specialist lender or digital bank.  You'll need to commit the capacity expected of a full-time executive board role. Why you should join SumUp You'll help shape a new bank for the businesses that keep local economies moving.  You'll have the influence to define its commercial direction and customer proposition, while building the governance and trust that let it grow for the long term.  It's a chance to bring together your banking experience and your builder mindset at a defining moment for SumUp.   Job Application Tip We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent German and based in Germany

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Experience leading and engaging a remote team across multiple cities
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent German and based in Germany

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Experience leading and engaging a remote team across multiple cities
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

title: Growth
description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. The Role You generate pipeline for our account executives (AEs) in the markets where dollar access is hardest. Most of it happens in person, at conferences and the events around them. In between, you find the next targets and make sure every lead lands with the right AE. You also own the numbers behind the top of the funnel and use them to recommend where the team spends its time next, including which new markets are worth testing. You'll help shape how we run Growth, with real autonomy and a scope that grows with what you show. Your First Six Months Months 1-2: Learn the product, our ICP and how we sell to banks and fintechs. Shadow our sales conversations, and get to know our stack, our playbooks and the way we operate. Go to your first conference with the team: help with pre-booking, work the floor alongside our Sales and Growth teams, and book your first meetings. By the end of month two, you can pitch Augustus on your own. Months 3-4: Execution is yours. Own a conference end to end, from the target list to the follow-up: book the meetings, route each one to the right AE and make sure it happens. Take meetings on your own and work closely with Sales and Marketing. Months 5-6: Own the pipeline for a set of markets and run your first event. You've turned what you've learned into data: which conferences, intros and markets bring deals that close, and which don't. You sync with the rest of GTM to bring in what they see and use it to shape our market strategy: where we go next, how we go in, who we target first and what we lead with. Who Will Thrive At Augustus We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits: American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low. Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment. Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team. Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent. This role is for you if: You're outgoing and at your best in front of people. You can start a conversation with a stranger at a booth and hold it with a bank's CFO. You do what needs to be done, even when it's not glamorous: building a prospecting list, chasing a follow-up, carrying boxes to the booth. You think clearly and work from data. You take an unstructured dataset and come back with answers and insights. You're diligent and organised. Nothing falls through the cracks. You use AI to move fast, but don't trust the output blindly. You check results, question the systems and don't ship anything you wouldn't put your name on. You're curious: when something takes too long, you find a faster way to do it. After every conference, you know what you'd do differently next time, and you do it. This is not for you if: You'd rather work behind a screen than in front of people. Most of our pipeline starts with a conversation in person. You want a well-defined scope and clear processes. Ours change as we grow, and you'll help build many of them. You want a predictable week. Plans change, the bar is high and the hours are long. You expect your degree to count for more than your results. Hard Requirements You are currently pursuing or have obtained, in the last two years, a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a stellar institution. You have 1-2 previous internships or roles in high-growth startups, venture capital, private equity, consulting or investment banking, and/or you have demonstrated initiative through side projects, student organizations or entrepreneurial experiences. Fluent English. Spanish is a strong plus. You can travel regularly, often at short notice. Based in Berlin or willing to relocate. Pay transparency Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €60,000-€80,000 + equity and benefits. What We Offer Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before. Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities. Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner. Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget. Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team. Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. You generate pipeline for our account executives (AEs) in the markets where dollar access is hardest. Most of it happens in person, at conferences and the events around them. In between, you find the next targets and make sure every lead lands with the right AE.

You also own the numbers behind the top of the funnel and use them to recommend where the team spends its time next, including which new markets are worth testing. You'll help shape how we run Growth, with real autonomy and a scope that grows with what you show.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: Learn the product, our ICP and how we sell to banks and fintechs. Shadow our sales conversations, and get to know our stack, our playbooks and the way we operate. Go to your first conference with the team: help with pre-booking, work the floor alongside our Sales and Growth teams, and book your first meetings. By the end of month two, you can pitch Augustus on your own.

  • Months 3-4: Execution is yours. Own a conference end to end, from the target list to the follow-up: book the meetings, route each one to the right AE and make sure it happens. Take meetings on your own and work closely with Sales and Marketing.

  • Months 5-6: Own the pipeline for a set of markets and run your first event. You've turned what you've learned into data: which conferences, intros and markets bring deals that close, and which don't. You sync with the rest of GTM to bring in what they see and use it to shape our market strategy: where we go next, how we go in, who we target first and what we lead with.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You're outgoing and at your best in front of people. You can start a conversation with a stranger at a booth and hold it with a bank's CFO.

  • You do what needs to be done, even when it's not glamorous: building a prospecting list, chasing a follow-up, carrying boxes to the booth.

  • You think clearly and work from data. You take an unstructured dataset and come back with answers and insights.

  • You're diligent and organised. Nothing falls through the cracks.

  • You use AI to move fast, but don't trust the output blindly. You check results, question the systems and don't ship anything you wouldn't put your name on.

  • You're curious: when something takes too long, you find a faster way to do it.

  • After every conference, you know what you'd do differently next time, and you do it.

This is not for you if:

  • You'd rather work behind a screen than in front of people. Most of our pipeline starts with a conversation in person.

  • You want a well-defined scope and clear processes. Ours change as we grow, and you'll help build many of them.

  • You want a predictable week. Plans change, the bar is high and the hours are long.

  • You expect your degree to count for more than your results.

Hard Requirements

  • You are currently pursuing or have obtained, in the last two years, a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a stellar institution.

  • You have 1-2 previous internships or roles in high-growth startups, venture capital, private equity, consulting or investment banking, and/or you have demonstrated initiative through side projects, student organizations or entrepreneurial experiences.

  • Fluent English. Spanish is a strong plus.

  • You can travel regularly, often at short notice.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €60,000-€80,000 + equity and benefits.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

Compensation: €60K – €80K • Offers Equity

raw.title: Team Lead - Perception
raw.description:
Join SE3 Labs as Team Lead - Perception

Build and lead the team that teaches SE3's autonomous systems to see, and ship perception that holds up on real missions.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Perception team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Perception Team Lead, you'll own SE3's perception stack end to end: the technical roadmap, the architecture and the core algorithmic decisions behind object detection, tracking, semantic segmentation and depth estimation. You'll hire and grow the team, set the engineering bar and stay hands-on, working closely with our founders and autonomy engineers as systems move from recorded data to field trials. What you build decides how well our platforms understand the world around them in real operations.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Perception Roadmap: Own the technical roadmap for perception, deciding what we build, in which order and how we measure progress.

  • Architecture & Algorithms: Define the architecture of the perception stack and make the core algorithmic decisions across detection, tracking, segmentation and depth.

  • Detection & Tracking: Ship object detection and multi-object tracking that stay reliable on real mission data from our autonomous platforms.

  • Segmentation & Depth: Deliver semantic segmentation and depth estimation that give downstream autonomy a dependable picture of the scene.

  • Evaluation & Replay: Build the evaluation and replay loop so the team iterates mostly on recorded data, with clear metrics, benchmark datasets and regression tests.

  • Real-World Deployment: Take models from training to onboard compute and field trials, and improve them until they work under real operating conditions.

  • Team Building: Hire the perception team, set the bar for engineering quality and mentor engineers while staying hands-on in the code.

     
 

Your Profile

  • You take ownership of hard technical problems and lead from the front, staying hands-on while setting direction for others.

  • You hold a Ph.D. with 3+ years of industry experience, or an M.Sc. with 6+ years, in Computer Vision, Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • You have a proven record of building perception systems that shipped and worked in the real world, in robotics, autonomous driving, AR/VR, drones or adjacent domains.

  • You bring deep expertise across modern perception, including object detection, tracking, segmentation and depth estimation, and you base architecture decisions on evaluation data.

  • You have led engineering teams, including hiring, setting technical direction and growing people.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Publications at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS or similar venues.

  • Experience building a team or technical function at an early-stage company.

  • Supervising students or researchers and turning research into product.

  • Deploying models on real-time, resource-constrained compute such as Jetson-class platforms.

  • Field experience with UAVs or other robots that get tested outside the lab.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Coding / Algorithm Interview: (90 min): We work through a practical perception, estimation, or robotics software problem together

  3. Technical Interview (1 hr): We dive into perception systems you have built and shipped, the hardest technical decisions you have made and how you raise the bar for a team.

  4. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

raw.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Feature Owner Team

Wayve’s Product & Delivery team turns our AI Driver technology into valuable, scalable vehicle capabilities for global OEM partners. We work at the intersection of customer needs, product strategy and engineering delivery—defining what great looks like, aligning teams around a clear outcome and ensuring that Wayve’s technology can be brought to market safely and effectively.

As part of this team, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of specific Parking functionalities. You’ll work closely with OEM customers, product and engineering teams to define feature scope, set performance targets and guide delivery from concept through to production. Your work will directly shape how Wayve’s technology performs for customers and drivers as we progress towards higher levels of autonomy.

  • Act as the accountable product owner for specific Parking features, ensuring they are delivered on time, to the agreed specification and in line with customer and business needs.

  • Partner closely with OEM customers to understand their requirements, represent their needs internally and align expectations without compromising Wayve’s product strategy.

  • Work with feature group owners and engineering teams to define feature scope, specifications, performance targets and delivery plans.

  • Partner with systems, hardware, perception, platform, safety and supplier teams to shape the Parking sensor and compute architecture.

  • Drive integration and issue resolution across the Parking sensor stack, including ultrasonic sensors (USS) and surround-view cameras (SVCs).

  • Engage throughout feature development, providing early feedback, participating in testing and supporting evaluation and validation activities.

  • Identify risks early, manage trade-offs and keep teams aligned as customer priorities, platform constraints and the technology evolve.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of Parking features, including Park Distance Control, Rear-AEB, Auto-Park Assist, Remote Park Assist and Memory Parking.

  • Defining and evolving feature specifications in partnership with OEMs, engineering and product teams.

  • Translating sensor, compute and platform constraints into clear feature scope, performance targets and delivery trade-offs.

  • Leading integration across the Parking sensor stack, including USS and SVCs, and resolving sensor-specific performance and integration issues.

  • Harmonising customer requirements across OEM partners to maximise reusable assets, scalability and efficient feature delivery.

  • Setting clear performance targets and ensuring features meet customer requirements, internal capabilities and agreed delivery specifications.

  • Supporting testing, evaluation and validation to ensure feature quality and readiness for production.

  • Maintaining and evolving the strategic feature roadmap as Wayve’s technology advances towards higher levels of autonomy.

  • Participating in agile planning and delivery rituals, helping teams manage dependencies, risks and priorities effectively.

  • Ensuring feature delivery aligns with relevant automotive quality, safety and compliance expectations.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have strong experience specifying and delivering Parking features from concept through to production, particularly Park Distance Control, Rear-AEB, Auto-Park Assist, Remote Park Assist or Memory Parking.

  • You understand automotive development processes, including requirements management, the V-model, ASPICE, quality and validation.

  • You are confident working directly with OEM customers: understanding their needs, negotiating requirements and representing their perspective internally while maintaining a clear view of Wayve’s product strategy.

  • You have sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with engineering teams on Parking feature trade-offs, feasibility, testing, evaluation and validation.

  • You have experience defining and integrating automotive Parking sensor systems, including USS and SVCs, with practical knowledge of interfaces, calibration, diagnostics, supplier management and sensor-specific integration and performance issues.

  • You have delivered ADAS or Parking features on resource-constrained automotive SoCs, with a practical understanding of how compute, memory, bandwidth, latency and thermal budgets shape system architecture, feature behaviour, performance and customer experience.

  • You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can bridge technical and commercial perspectives, creating alignment across customers, product, systems, hardware, perception, platform, safety and engineering teams.

  • You proactively identify risks and issues before they escalate, balancing immediate delivery needs with the longer-term product roadmap.

  • Experience shipping complete Parking features into large-scale automotive production programmes would be valuable.

  • Knowledge of automotive quality, safety and compliance standards—including ASPICE, SOTIF, functional safety, NCAP, UNECE, GSR-II and DCAS—would be valuable.

  • Experience with AI/ML, LLMs or recent generative-AI methods and architectures would be beneficial.

  • You bring curiosity and a forward-looking approach to developing new Parking capabilities and advancing the customer experience.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our Germany office. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces and workshops with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency interviews (product ownership, customer collaboration and cross-functional delivery)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Parking and ADAS domain knowledge, feature delivery and product thinking)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

  • Design, implement, and maintain C++ application software for ADAS and active-safety-related vehicle features.

  • Work with ML engineers to understand model outputs, limitations, failure modes, and how these translate into vehicle behaviour.

  • Use logs, simulation, replay, and vehicle testing to debug, tune, and validate feature behaviour.

  • Define and improve metrics, test cases, and validation strategies for ADAS feature performance, robustness, and quality.

  • Collaborate with product, systems, vehicle integration, and OEM-facing teams to translate requirements and real-world constraints into engineering solutions.

  • Support field testing and iterative development, including investigation of vehicle issues, edge cases, and performance gaps.

  • Contribute to software architecture, code quality, tooling, and engineering practices for feature development.

Essential

  • Strong C++ software engineering experience, ideally in production or safety-relevant systems.

  • Hands-on experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, robotics, vehicle software, active safety, or closely related domains.

  • Practical understanding of vehicle feature development, including real-world testing, simulation, replay, logs, or prototype vehicle debugging.

  • Ability to reason about vehicle behaviour, sensor/model inputs, timing, failure modes, and feature-level decision logic.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as ML, perception, planning, controls, vehicle integration, product, or systems engineering.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make pragmatic engineering trade-offs under ambiguity.

  • A quality mindset, with experience writing testable, maintainable software and using data to validate behaviour.

Desirable

  • Experience with ADAS features such as AEB, ISA, AES, ACC, lane keeping, collision avoidance, trajectory validation, or active safety systems.

  • Experience at an automotive OEM, Tier 1 supplier, autonomous driving company, robotics company, or vehicle technology startup.

  • Familiarity with ML or AI-based autonomy systems, including how model outputs are consumed by downstream software.

  • Experience with ROS, Linux, Bazel, CMake, Docker, QNX, protobuf, MCAP, CAN, calibration, or vehicle logging systems.

  • Experience with vehicle test tracks, public-road testing, HIL/SIL, scenario-based testing, or NCAP-style validation.

  • Familiarity with tools used in automotive development and testing, such as CANoe, Vector tools, MicroAutoBox, or similar.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. title: E-Commerce Integration Specialist (m/w/d)
description: Rügamer & Steiner entwickelt E-Mail-Marketing für Online-Shops. Damit unser Team für einen neuen Kunden loslegen kann, müssen Shop und Klaviyo sauber zusammenspielen. Du übernimmst diese Anbindung, klärst technische Fragen direkt mit dem Kunden und seiner Shopagentur und prüfst, ob alles für den Start bereit ist. Was du übernimmst • Du bindest Kundenshops an Klaviyo an, richtest die Integration ein und prüfst, ob die benötigten Daten und Shop-Ereignisse ankommen. • Du führst technische Onboarding-Termine. Du erklärst, welche Zugänge oder Änderungen nötig sind, und hältst die offenen Punkte bis zur Übergabe nach. • Du gehst Fehlern in bestehenden Anbindungen nach, etwa wenn Bestellereignisse fehlen oder eine Schnittstelle nicht mehr zuverlässig läuft. Bei Änderungen am Live-Shop planst du die Prüfung mit ein. • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Account Management zusammen. Das Team weiß von dir, was bereits funktioniert, was noch offen ist und wann es mit der Übergabe rechnen kann. • Wenn sich ein technischer Schritt bei mehreren Kunden wiederholt, kannst du ein Skript, ein internes Tool oder ein Plugin bauen, das die Arbeit beim nächsten Onboarding vereinfacht. So startest du Du lernst unsere Klaviyo-Setups und die Onboarding-Checkliste an konkreten Kundenfällen kennen. Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du technische Termine und eigene Anbindungen. Nach drei Monaten ist das Ziel, dass du ein Standard-Onboarding vom ersten technischen Kundentermin bis zur geprüften Übergabe selbstständig durchführst. Was du mitbringst • Du hast schon selbst eine Integration eingerichtet, einen technischen Fehler behoben oder ein funktionierendes Projekt mit KI-Agenten umgesetzt. Erfahrung mit laufenden E-Commerce-Shops ist ein Plus. • Du kannst mit KI-Agenten arbeiten und programmieren. Du zerlegst technische Aufgaben in Schritte, prüfst den erzeugten Code und testest, ob die Lösung funktioniert. • Du kannst nachvollziehen, wie Daten zwischen Shop und angebundenen Systemen fließen. Du findest dich in APIs, Shop-Apps und technischen Einstellungen wie DNS zurecht. • Du kannst erklären, wie du eine Änderung an einem laufenden Shop vorbereitest, prüfst und bei Bedarf zurücknimmst. • Du kannst technische Probleme im Kundengespräch verständlich erklären und mit Kunden und Agenturen konkrete nächste Schritte vereinbaren. • Erfahrung mit Shopware, Magento oder ähnlich komplexen Shop-Setups ist besonders interessant. Klaviyo-Erfahrung ist willkommen. Unsere Abläufe lernst du bei uns kennen. Was dich erwartet Du bekommst früh eigene Kundenfälle und entscheidest bei Standardanbindungen selbst, wie du sie umsetzt. Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Shopsystemen und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit beim Kunden verändert. Wenn du merkst, dass ein eigenes Tool einen wiederkehrenden Engpass löst, kannst du es bauen und in den nächsten Onboardings einsetzen. Rahmenbedingungen • Düsseldorf, fünf Tage pro Woche vor Ort • Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche, Festanstellung • 50.000–100.000 € brutto pro Jahr, je nach Erfahrung und Entwicklung in der Rolle Bewirb dich Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Beispiel für eine Shop-Integration, einen technischen Fehler, den du gelöst hast, oder ein Projekt, das du mit KI-Agenten umgesetzt hast. Du weißt, wie man Stories schreibt, die sowohl Creators als auch Zielgruppen begeistern, und bringst idealerweise auch Dreherfahrung mit.</li> <li>Dein Mindset: Du bist eigeninitiativ, strategisch denkend, verantwortungsbewusst und arbeitest lösungsorientiert mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.</li> <li>Deine Skills: Du präsentierst und argumentierst stark auf Deutsch (mind. C1) sowie sehr gut auf Englisch.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du: <strong>#teamplayer #motiviert #neugierig</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p><strong>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</strong></p> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. title: Forward Deployed Researcher (Robot Learning)
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. You will train and deploy modern neural robotic policies for real customer tasks. This is an early-career role for someone whose strongest experience may come from a university laboratory, thesis, internship, or recent research position. We care about the depth of your work and your ability to learn quickly, not the number of years on your CV. What You Will Do Train neural policies for manipulation and other embodied tasks using real and simulated data. Build data, training, evaluation, and deployment pipelines for robotic policies. Run experiments in simulation and transfer successful policies onto real robots. Collect demonstrations and deployment data, diagnose failure modes, and improve policies iteratively. Evaluate models for robustness, generalisation, latency, and real-world task success. Work alongside deployment engineers at customer sites to adapt policies to new environments and workflows. Turn research ideas into systems that operate reliably outside the lab. Requirements Experience training modern neural-network-based robotic policies through a thesis, university laboratory, internship, research project, or early professional role. Familiarity with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, or related robot-learning methods. Strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch, JAX, or an equivalent framework. Experience running experiments on real robots or in a robotics simulator. Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals and experimental design. Evidence of strong technical work, such as a thesis, paper, research project, open-source contribution, or working robotic system. Comfortable moving between research code and physical hardware. Willingness to travel to deployment sites. Nice to Have Experience with manipulation, dexterous control, teleoperation, or whole-body policies. Familiarity with Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, ManiSkill, or similar environments. Experience with diffusion policies, transformers, multimodal models, or vision-language-action systems. Publications or workshop papers in robotics, computer vision, or machine learning. Experience collecting or curating robot-training data. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Dann bist du bei SquareNeo genau richtig! Du verantwortest Kundenprojekte von der Anforderung bis zur fertigen Lösung auf Basis des SalesCoach und bist dabei die zentrale Ansprechperson für den Kunden. Wir lösen die kniffligen Fälle. Du denkst dich tief in die Vertriebsstrukturen, die Produkt- und Regelwelt und die IT-Landschaft unserer Kunden ein und entwickelst daraus Lösungen, die sich umsetzen lassen und einen messbaren Mehrwert bringen. Und ganz wichtig: Du bringst dich aktiv ein. Wir wollen wachsen und freuen uns daher über all deine Ideen! Du kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell durchdringen und sie für Fachbereich und Entwicklung gleichermaßen verständlich machen. Erfahrung mit KI und LLMs ist ein Plus. Tiefes Wissen baust du bei uns auf, auch über Schulungen zu aktuellen Themen. Muss-Kriterium: Viele unserer Kunden sind im deutschsprachigen Raum ansässig und auch die Teamsprache ist Deutsch. Deutschkenntnisse auf dem Niveau C1 sind daher nötig. Du hast eine Leidenschaft für technologische Innovationen und die Motivation, kontinuierlich Neues zu lernen. title: Senior Leadership & AI Enablement Consultant (w/d/m)
description: Führungskräfte sollen entscheiden, wo AI in ihrem Bereich hilft. Viele können nicht einschätzen, ob ein Prozess RPA, generative AI oder einen Agenten braucht und ob die Daten reichen. Mit dir lernen sie das an einem eigenen Use Case, den sie über mehrere Wochen bearbeiten. WE BUILD AI ist eine AI-Beratung mit eigenem Engineering in Köln. Wir sind rund zehn Leute und arbeiten mit Mittelstand und Konzernen. Uns geht es um AI, die in Prozessen und in der Wertschöpfung wirkt. Deine Rolle Gemeinsam mit einer Partnerberatung für Führung und Change bauen wir gerade ein Programm für Führungskräfte im Konzernumfeld auf. Es verbindet Präsenzblöcke, eine Praxisphase am eigenen Use Case und Coaching über mehrere Wochen. Du leitest Präsenzblöcke allein und deckst dabei Führung, Technologie, Prozesse und Daten ab, immer aus Sicht der Führungskraft. Dafür bist du etwa einmal im Monat für zwei Tage vor Ort, in NRW und Norddeutschland. Die übrige Zeit arbeitest du in unserem Trainingsbereich, den wir gerade ausbauen. Dort gibst du Trainings und Workshops bei weiteren Kund:innen und sammelst Use Cases für unsere Discovery Sprints. Deine Arbeit wirkt, wenn Use Cases nach dem Training weiterlaufen und Projekte daraus entstehen. Aufgaben Du leitest Präsenzblöcke von zwei Tagen allein und führst die Gruppe von der eigenen Rolle bis zur Entscheidungsvorlage. Technologie erklärst du so, dass Führungskräfte einordnen können, was RPA, klassische AI, generative AI und Agents leisten. Mit Design Thinking und Service Design führst du die Teilnehmenden vom Pain Point zum priorisierten Use Case. In der Praxisphase coachst du die Gruppe remote und gibst Feedback auf Problemdefinition, Datenlage und erste Lösungsideen. Übergaben und Trainingsdesign stimmst du eng mit den Trainer:innen der Partnerberatung ab. Die Inhalte prüfst du jedes Quartal und passt Beispiele und Übungen an neue Entwicklungen an. Außerhalb des Programms gibst du Trainings und Workshops und bringst vielversprechende Use Cases in Discovery Sprints. Formate, Methoden und Vorlagen für unseren Trainingsbereich baust du mit auf. Was du mitbringst Du hast mehrere Jahre Trainings oder Workshops für Führungskräfte gegeben, gern auch mehrtägige Formate. Eine Gruppe aus Abteilungs- und Bereichsleitungen hältst du zwei Tage allein bei der Sache, auch bei kritischen Rückfragen. AI nutzt du selbst jeden Tag. Wie Sprachmodelle und Agents funktionieren und wo ihre Grenzen liegen, kannst du einfach erklären. Design Thinking, Service Design oder Prozessanalyse hast du in echten Projekten eingesetzt. Bei Daten bleibst du skeptisch und erkennst, wann ein Dashboard eine Entscheidung trägt. Erfahrung mit großen Organisationen hilft, etwa mit Betriebsrat, Datenschutz und AI Act. Idealerweise kommst du aus Beratung, Learning & Development, Organisationsentwicklung oder Change Management. Reisen gehört für dich dazu, und Deutsch sprichst du verhandlungssicher. Was wir bieten Remote-Arbeit mit regelmäßigen Teamtagen in unserem Büro in Köln-Ehrenfeld, wo Getränke, Snacks und Bürohunde warten. Ein Trainingsbereich, der gerade entsteht und den du von Anfang an mitgestaltest. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege. Mentoring und ehrliches Feedback, das dich weiterbringt. Benefit-Budget von 30 Euro im Monat für Gutscheine bei über 100 Anbietern, Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket. Dienstrad-Leasing per Gehaltsumwandlung mit bis zu 40 Prozent Ersparnis, Vollkasko und Wartung inklusive. Teamevents und gemeinsame Workations. So läuft die Bewerbung Kennenlern-Call mit Mounir und Frederic, etwa 30 Minuten. Wir sprechen über dich und über uns und schauen, ob die Grundlage stimmt. Probesequenz im Call, 45 bis 60 Minuten. Du bereitest eine Trainingseinheit für Führungskräfte vor und führst sie mit uns durch. Kennenlernen vor Ort in Köln mit gemeinsamem Essen, Einblicken in unsere Projekte und Sparring mit dem Team. title: Manager Amazon
description: Über uns Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Deine Mission bei uns Möchtest Du den Erfolg unserer Gesundheitsmarken auf Amazon mitgestalten und mit kreativen, datenbasierten Lösungen neue Maßstäbe setzen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Als Manager Amazon verantwortest Du unseren Amazon-Vertriebskanal ganzheitlich und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Healthcare-Produkte sichtbar, verfügbar und erfolgreich sind. Hilf uns dabei, Millionen von Menschen ein längeres und gesünderes Leben zu ermöglichen. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst einen einheitlichen, überzeugenden und performanceorientierten Markenauftritt auf unseren Product Detail Pages (PDPs) sowie in unseren Amazon-Werbeanzeigen. Du koordinierst und setzt die Ausspielung unserer Amazon-Werbekampagnen gemeinsam mit dem Online-Marketing-Team um und fungierst als Sparringspartner, um eine optimale Kampagnen- und Umsatzperformance sicherzustellen. Du erstellst regelmäßige Reportings zu Umsatz, Marktanteilen und Kampagnenperformance und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Du planst in enger Abstimmung mit unserem Logistikteam die Lagerbestände bei Amazon und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Produktverfügbarkeit. Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für unsere Key Accounts bei Amazon und löst operative Probleme wie Produktsperrungen mit kreativen und effizienten Lösungsansätzen. Du beobachtest Wettbewerber, Markttrends und Amazon-Richtlinienänderungen und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale für unseren Kanal ab. Du behältst die Kundenzufriedenheit im Blick, analysierst Bewertungen, erkennst Trends frühzeitig und stimmst Dich bei Kundenanfragen eng mit unserem Kundenservice ab. Du bist intern die erste Anlaufstelle für Amazon-spezifische Fragen und arbeitest dich schnell und eigenständig in buchhalterische sowie rechtliche Themen ein. Dein Profil Du hast Dein Studium, z.B. im Bereich BWL, (Digitales) Marketing, Wirtschaftsinformatik, erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem analytisch geprägten Umfeld mit, beispielsweise mit Bezug zum Online-Marketing (idealerweise Amazon) oder als Product Owner. Du bist gut darin kreative Lösungsansätze zu finden und zeichnest Dich durch Deine Hartnäckigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit aus. Du bist kommunikativ, scheust Dich aber auch nicht davor, wenn nötig, mit Formularen zu arbeiten. Du hast Freude daran, quantitative Analysen in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen zu übersetzen, diese mit dem Top-Management zu diskutieren und eigenverantwortlich umzusetzen. Du beherrschst das MS-Office-Paket, insbesondere Excel, sicher und verfügst über Erfahrung mit Amazon-spezifischen Tools wie Seller Central, Amazon Ads, Helium 10, Jungle Scout oder Data Dive. Kenntnisse in Visualisierungstools wie Tableau oder Power BI sind ein Plus. Du bringst verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level) mit. Weitere Sprachen wie Französisch, Italienisch oder Spanisch sind ein Plus. Unser Versprechen Wir bieten Dir einen vielfältigen, anspruchsvollen Job mit spannenden Aufgaben und einem breiten Spektrum an Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten! Unser innovatives Umfeld ermöglicht Dir Deine berufliche Entfaltung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Verantwortung von Tag 1 an und den Freiraum, neue Wege zu gehen. Auf Dich wartet individuelles Learning und echte Sinnhaftigkeit – schenke mit Deinem persönlichen Beitrag Millionen von Menschen ein neues Leben! Du hast Rückfragen? Wende Dich gerne direkt an Deine zuständige Ansprechpartnerin: FUTRUE GmbH Vanessa Köpfler Am Haag 14 82166 Gräfelfing https://futrue.com Bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. *Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Anzeige die männliche Form verwendet. Sie bezieht sich ausdrücklich auf alle Geschlechter (w/m/d).
