description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Our EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic, fast-growing group that loves turning customers into enthusiastic Stripe advocates. We work hand-in-hand with our Sales team to build demand, help users get the most out of our products, and craft marketing plans that truly resonate with local audiences.</p> <p>We have a lot still to build, and we’re tackling it as a diverse, international team that thrives on collaboration, bold innovation, and genuine curiosity. If you love to learn and want to make a meaningful impact, we’d love to have you join us.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <p>As a senior individual contributor, you’ll align regional and global marketing teams around shared priorities for EMEA Velocity, secure investment to deliver them, and balance global strategy with regional needs. You’ll directly lead high-priority initiatives across the region.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll shape how Stripe grows its Velocity segment across EMEA, with a particular focus on winning and expanding relationships with priority commercial accounts. You’ll combine regional strategy with hands-on field marketing, building programs that generate demand and accelerate pipeline across different markets.</p> <p>As the primary marketing partner on the EMEA Velocity leadership team, you’ll own the regional marketing strategy and investment plan. You’ll work closely with Sales leadership to identify the biggest opportunities across markets, decide where marketing can make the greatest difference, and turn those priorities into measurable business results.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll lead account-based programs, executive engagement, and market-relevant campaigns for priority commercial accounts, bringing together regional and global teams to deliver them. Your programs will engage senior decision makers and operational leaders on reducing developer complexity, improving conversion, and increasing the return on their financial infrastructure. You’ll also partner with Demand Generation on scaled digital demand campaigns and programs, connecting those efforts with regional business priorities.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>As a senior individual contributor, you’ll lead through influence across markets and teams, aligning Sales, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and Global Campaigns around a shared plan. You’ll balance regional priorities with local customer needs, use results to guide investment, and build approaches that can scale across EMEA. You’ll help shape the marketing approach and directly lead the initiatives where regional context and ownership matter most.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define and own the integrated marketing strategy for the Velocity segment across EMEA, turning business goals, market dynamics, customer needs, and competitors into clear priorities.</li> <li>Partner with regional Sales and Sales Development (SDR) leadership to set shared priorities, take part in pipeline reviews, and steer marketing investments.</li> <li>Build full-funnel campaigns around the problems businesses are trying to solve, such as taking payments online, growing recurring revenue, and getting paid faster.</li> <li>Lead high-touch field marketing, targeted account-based programs, and executive events, including dinners and roadshows, for priority commercial accounts. Partner with Demand Generation on scaled digital demand campaigns and programs, connecting those programs with regional Sales priorities.</li> <li>&nbsp;</li> <li>Co-market with the SaaS Platforms and Partner teams to reach merchants through the software they already use.</li> <li>Build Stripe’s brand with these businesses through customer stories, executive engagement, and industry initiatives, and lead the programs yourself where local context and senior ownership matter most.</li> <li>Own the regional marketing budget and use pipeline generation, pipeline progression, priority-account engagement, and ROI to guide investment. Partner with relevant teams to measure contributions to product adoption and customer advocacy, and use results to prioritise, scale, or change programs.</li> <li>Bring regional and global teams (including Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and Global Campaigns) together to deliver the plan, and adapt global strategy to local buyer expectations, regulation, and the competitive landscape.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3> <p>You’re an experienced B2B marketing leader who has owned an integrated marketing strategy across a country, region, or comparably broad portfolio. If you meet them, we encourage you to apply. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><em>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>A propos de WPP Media&nbsp;:</strong></p> <p><strong><em>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance.&nbsp;</em></strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie.&nbsp;<br>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing.&nbsp;<br>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients.&nbsp;Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Le contexte</strong> :</p> <p>Rejoignez WPP Consulting, une équipe à taille humaine dédiée au conseil stratégique, à la transformation des organisations et au développement de dispositifs de formation innovants.</p> <p>Vous interviendrez sur des problématiques business variés auprès de clients leaders dans les secteurs des médias, du divertissement et de la communication.</p> <p>Pleinement intégré à l'équipe, vous participerez aux différentes étapes des missions de conseil, du cadrage stratégique à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle, avec une autonomie et des responsabilités progressives.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Conseil, recherche &amp; analyse :</strong> analyser des problématiques business, réaliser des benchmarks, des études de marché et des analyses afin d’identifier les principaux enseignements et contribuer à formuler des recommandations.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Entretiens &amp; ateliers :</strong> préparer et participer aux échanges avec les clients et experts métiers, puis structurer et synthétiser les enseignements.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Production de livrables :</strong> concevoir des présentations de conseil claires et impactantes, en travaillant la structuration, le storytelling et la visualisation des données.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Transformation &amp; accompagnement client :</strong> contribuer à la conception et au déploiement de projets de transformation et de formation, en lien avec les différentes parties prenantes. <br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <p>Votre Expérience :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Formation :</strong> Etudiant en Master 1 ou Master 2 (Bac+4/5) en école de commerce, école d'ingénieurs, IEP ou université, avec une spécialisation en stratégie, management, économie ou marketing.</li> <li><strong>Expérience précédente :</strong> Une première expérience en conseil, stratégie, analyse business ou gestion de projet est appréciée.</li> <li><strong>Secteur :</strong> Intérêt marqué pour les problématiques de transformation, les enjeux business et les secteurs des médias, du divertissement et de la communication.</li> </ul> <p>Vos Compétences Techniques :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Langues :</strong> Bon niveau d'anglais B2/C1 (lecture de documentation et production de livrables destinés à des interlocuteurs internationaux).</li> <li><strong>Bureautique/Outils :</strong> Excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint (structuration d'idées, storytelling, réalisation de slides de conseil) et bonne aisance sur Excel (sensibilité aux chiffres, analyse de données).</li> <li><strong>Recherche &amp; Analyse &amp; IA :</strong> capacité à rechercher, croiser et synthétiser l’information, avec une appétence pour les outils d’IA et un regard critique.</li> </ul> <p>Vos Qualités Humaines :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Esprit analytique &amp; curiosité :</strong> capacité à comprendre rapidement des problématiques complexes, questionner l’information et en dégager les enjeux clés.</li> <li><strong>Autonomie &amp; proactivité :</strong> capacité à avancer de manière autonome, anticiper les prochaines étapes et être force de proposition.</li> <li><strong>Rigueur &amp; organisation :</strong> capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle et à produire des livrables de qualité.</li> <li><strong>Posture conseil &amp; relationnel :</strong> aisance à l’oral comme à l’écrit et capacité à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés et exigeants.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Ce que nous offrons&nbsp;:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une <strong>expérience professionnelle unique</strong> au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.</li> <li>L'opportunité de travailler avec des <strong>clients de premier plan</strong> et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.</li> <li>Un <strong>accompagnement personnalisé</strong> pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas&nbsp;!</li> <li><strong>Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks</strong> ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.</li> <li>Un <strong>campus</strong> à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3&nbsp;!</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Process de recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.</li> <li>Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste.</li> <li>Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.</li> </ul> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: L’ Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé. Vous rejoindrez l’équipe “Personnes morales” du domaine Annuaires, au sein de la Direction des Opérations (DOPS) , chargée de la refonte du répertoire FINESS . La nouvelle version du référentiel est en service depuis juillet 2026 et les travaux de mise en qualité des données se poursuivent, notamment sur les données SIRENE et sur les informations relatives aux structures sanitaires et médico-sociales. Référentiel national essentiel à l’identification des établissements, FINESS contribue au pilotage de l’offre de soins, au financement et au contrôle des structures, à l’orientation des usagers et à l’interopérabilité des systèmes d’information en santé. Vous travaillerez au sein d’une équipe produit pluridisciplinaire organisée en méthode Scrum. 🎯 Missions principales Analyse et fiabilisation des données Analyser la qualité des données SIRENE présentes dans le référentiel FINESS et reprendre les travaux de la précédente campagne. Échanger avec la DREES pour valider le modèle de données et réaliser des contrôles de qualité. Analyser l’impact des mises à jour annuelles du référentiel géographique sur les données FINESS. Amélioration des processus et documentation Proposer des modalités d’articulation entre automatisation des corrections et recensement des corrections à effectuer. Participer, avec l’équipe Data, à la mise en place d’un portail de signalement des anomalies. Documenter les méthodes, traitements et résultats afin de faciliter la continuité des travaux. 🧑‍🎓 Profil recherché Vous êtes étudiant·e en études supérieures, de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5, dans un cursus orienté Data Analyst, analyse de données ou systèmes d’information. About PUR

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

Position Summary

The Heah of Accounting is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of PUR's accounting records and financial reporting across the Group. The role oversees day-to-day accounting operations, coordinates monthly and annual closings, manages statutory and tax compliance, and serves as the primary accounting counterpart for Regional Accounting and Finance Managers in Latin America, Africa, and Asia.

You will lead a team of two accounting professionals and contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes, internal controls, and reporting systems to support PUR's growth and international operations.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Operations & Financial Close

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes for Group entities.

  • Ensure timely and accurate recording of accounting transactions in accordance with local GAAP and Group accounting policies.

  • Review and validate general ledger entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

  • Monitor accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, and intercompany transactions.

  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of accounting practices across entities.

Group Coordination

  • Act as the primary accounting liaison with Regional Accounting and Finance Managers in: Latin America, Africa and Asia

  • Coordinate closing calendars, reporting packages, and accounting guidelines.

  • Support regional teams in resolving complex accounting matters and ensuring compliance with Group policies.

  • Review key accounting judgments and significant transactions across regions.

Statutory Accounts & Compliance

  • Coordinate preparation of annual statutory financial statements.

  • Ensure compliance with local accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements.

  • Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, accountants, and regulatory authorities.

  • Support the preparation of audit files and responses to audit requests.

  • Monitor evolving accounting and regulatory requirements and ensure appropriate implementation.

Consolidation & Group Reporting

  • Support the preparation of consolidated financial information for management and shareholders.

  • Ensure timely submission of reporting packages from regional entities.

  • Review intercompany balances and transactions and coordinate reconciliation processes.

  • Assist in the implementation and maintenance of Group reporting standards.

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

  • Maintain robust accounting controls and documentation.

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting activities.

  • Strengthen financial controls, accounting procedures, and reporting accuracy.

  • Contribute to ERP and finance system optimization initiatives.

Treasury & Cash Management Support

  • Monitor cash accounting and treasury-related transactions.

  • Ensure proper accounting treatment of financing arrangements, loans, and intercompany funding.

  • Support working capital management through accurate balance sheet monitoring.

Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop two accounting team members.

  • Allocate responsibilities and monitor workload to ensure efficiency and quality.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Support training and professional development initiatives.


We are looking for a candidate with:

  • Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • DEC, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent is a plus.

  • 8+ years of accounting experience in an international environment.

  • Experience leading accounting teams and managing audits.

  • Multi-country accounting exposure preferred.

  • Audit firm experience is a plus.

  • Strong knowledge of French GAAP and international accounting standards.

  • Consolidation, intercompany accounting, and multi-currency environments.

  • ERP experience (NetSuite is a plus).

  • Advanced Excel skills.

  • Leadership and stakeholder management.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.

  • Attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to work across cultures and time zones.

Key Success Factors

During the first 12 months, the successful candidate will:

  • Ensure timely and accurate monthly closings across all entities.

  • Improve balance sheet reconciliation quality and documentation.

  • Strengthen collaboration with regional finance teams.

  • Enhance accounting controls and audit readiness.

  • Contribute to the standardization and automation of accounting processes.

  • Support the continued scalability of PUR's global finance function.

title: Investor Relations | Closing & Structuration
description: Contrat : CDI - Temps plein Lieu : Paris 2e (Opéra) - Télétravail partiel possible Prise de poste : Début 2027 Rattachement : Direction du Pôle Revenu L'exigence d'un fonds. L'impact d'un rôle Closer / Builder. Sowefund, groupe Founders Future, ouvre l'accès au Venture Capital aux investisseurs privés. Notre activité historique (le Deal-by-Deal Primaire) a démontré la solidité de son modèle et sa rentabilité : notre collecte a progressé de 50 % sur les douze derniers mois. En 2027, nous changeons d'échelle sur ce moteur tout en déployant deux nouvelles lignes d'investissement : notre offre de Secondaire, ainsi qu'un troisième produit structurant (confidentiel à ce stade). Nous sommes à un point d'inflexion et recherchons un profil alliant une forte fibre commerciale à une réelle capacité de structuration, pour s'appuyer sur ce socle rentable et devenir l'un des moteurs de notre prochaine phase de croissance. VOTRE RÔLE : LE TERRAIN ET L'EXCELLENCE OPÉRATIONNELLE Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction du Pôle Revenu, vous rejoignez une équipe Investor Relations véloce (3 postes en CDI : 2 Investor Relations dédiés à la collecte et 1 profil CSM / Ops dédié, accompagnés de 2 stagiaires) et travaillez en lien étroit avec les équipes Growth, Product et Admin. Votre mandat est double et allie l'exigence du terrain à la rigueur organisationnelle : 1. Le Closing et la Collecte (70 % - Votre focus principal) Vous êtes en première ligne sur un flux 100 % qualifié : intentions d'investissement, base d'investisseurs existants et leads entrants (pas de prospection à froid / cold calling), avec un fort levier sur les tickets intermédiaires (5 k€ à 20 k€). Vente consultative : vous engagez un dialogue direct et qualitatif avec des investisseurs exigeants (dirigeants, cadres supérieurs, entrepreneurs) pour qualifier leur potentiel, lever leurs freins et conclure les souscriptions. Animation et réinvestissement : vous réactivez notre communauté d'investisseurs autour des lancements et des clôtures pour développer le réinvestissement multi-produits. Montée en gamme : vous imposez un rythme soutenu dans la gestion de votre pipeline et accompagnez vos investisseurs dans la durée pour closer vos dossiers au-delà de 20 k€. 2. La Structuration (30 % - Votre levier d'accélération) Pour accompagner notre changement d'échelle, l'exécution commerciale doit s'appuyer sur une organisation irréprochable. Vous avez la capacité d'auditer et d'optimiser nos outils et nos parcours de distribution pour l'ensemble du pôle. Pilotage CRM et Pipeline : vous veillez à la parfaite tenue de notre CRM, structurez le suivi du pipeline et l'optimisez en continu. Build avec Product et Growth : vous mettez en place les automatisations (dont l'IA), les process de qualification et les séquences de conversion qui rendront l'équipe plus performante et l'expérience investisseur plus fluide. VOS PERSPECTIVES D'ÉVOLUTION À 6-12 MOIS Vous rejoignez une structure d'investissement en pleine accélération. Sur votre premier trimestre de présence : votre priorité est de maîtriser le run commercial sur nos offres, de délivrer des résultats tangibles de closing et de déployer vos premiers chantiers d'optimisation de process et de CRM. À horizon 6 à 12 mois : en fonction de la régularité de vos performances et de votre impact sur la structuration du pôle, votre périmètre d'intervention (business, pilotage et encadrement) a vocation à s'élargir significativement pour accompagner la montée en puissance de nos nouvelles lignes d'investissement et de l'équipe. Chez nous, la performance dicte l'évolution. LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS Un historique de performance avéré (3 à 6 ans d'expérience, pas un poste de sortie d'école) : vous venez d'un environnement exigeant (FinTech, WealthTech, plateforme d'investissement, scale-up B2B/B2C Premium ou gestion privée dynamique). Vous avez déjà prouvé votre capacité à conclure des opérations de manière autonome sur des cycles courts et moyens. Prise de poste : Début 2027

Rattachement : Direction du Pôle Revenu

L'exigence d'un fonds. L'impact d'un rôle Closer / Builder.

Sowefund, groupe Founders Future, ouvre l'accès au Venture Capital aux investisseurs privés. Notre activité historique (le Deal-by-Deal Primaire) a démontré la solidité de son modèle et sa rentabilité : notre collecte a progressé de 50 % sur les douze derniers mois.

En 2027, nous changeons d'échelle sur ce moteur tout en déployant deux nouvelles lignes d'investissement : notre offre de Secondaire, ainsi qu'un troisième produit structurant (confidentiel à ce stade). Nous sommes à un point d'inflexion et recherchons un profil alliant une forte fibre commerciale à une réelle capacité de structuration, pour s'appuyer sur ce socle rentable et devenir l'un des moteurs de notre prochaine phase de croissance.

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction du Pôle Revenu, vous rejoignez une équipe Investor Relations véloce (3 postes en CDI : 2 Investor Relations dédiés à la collecte et 1 profil CSM / Ops dédié, accompagnés de 2 stagiaires) et travaillez en lien étroit avec les équipes Growth, Product et Admin. About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent French and access to our Paris office

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent French and access to our Paris office

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

CAD & Structural Analysis: High proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred) and structural validation using both hand calculations and FEA for dynamic and fatigue load cases. Manufacturing & Sourcing: Strong command of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) across heavy-precision machining, welding, and industrial fabrication, with experience sourcing custom components and managing external suppliers. True "Builder" & Startup Mindset: Thrives with high autonomy and end-to-end ownership—equally comfortable defining technical specs, managing budgets, turning wrenches in the workshop, and running live field tests. En tant que membre du groupe international PureGym, qui compte plus de 2 millions de membres, nous faisons partie des trois plus grandes chaînes de fitness en Europe. Nous sommes ainsi idéalement positionnés pour poursuivre et réaliser nos objectifs ambitieux. À l’avenir, nous pourrons ainsi contribuer encore davantage à la forme physique et à la santé de la population suisse.

Pour renforcer notre équipe Group Fitness motivée à Geneve Cornavin, nous recherchons dès maintenant une personne passionnée par le sport pour le poste de Group Fitness Instructor (h/f/d), notamment pour les cours suivants et aux horaires indiqués :

LesMills BODYPUMP, M.A.X., RIDE, TONE, GRIT, ZUMBA, H.I.I.T., PILATES, BODYATTACK, BODYCOMBAT, YOGAFLOW/POWERYOGA, STEP.

-

Tu préfères travailler de manière flexible en tant qu’indépendant(e) ? Aucun problème – en alternative à un emploi salarié, nous te proposons également une collaboration en freelance avec une rémunération horaire plus élevée et attractive. N’hésite pas à nous en parler directement. Pour plus d’informations à ce sujet, nous t’invitons à contacter directement la direction du club.

Tes missions :

  • Tu animes les cours de Group Fitness et transmets tes connaissances avec beaucoup d’enthousiasme.

  • Tu es présent(e) pour nos membres et les accompagnes avant, pendant et après tes cours.

  • Tu prépares tes cours, maintiens une bonne dynamique de groupe et motives les participant(e)s tout au long de la séance.

  • Tu veilles au respect des règles de propreté et d’hygiène dans la salle de cours.

  • Tu connais nos offres ainsi que notre philosophie et sais les transmettre à nos membres.

  • Idéalement, tu organises toi-même tes remplacements et es également disposé(e) à remplacer d’autres instructeurs si nécessaire.


Ce que tu apportes :

  • Tu disposes déjà d’une solide expérience en tant que Group Fitness Instructor pour les types de cours mentionnés et peux présenter des diplômes de Group Fitness ou des diplômes reconnus dans les domaines du yoga et du Pilates.

  • Tu as le talent de motiver les autres et de les aider à atteindre le niveau supérieur à chaque entraînement.

  • Tu enthousiasmes nos membres grâce à la diversité de tes entraînements et encourages aussi bien les débutant(e)s que les participant(e)s avancé(e)s à se dépasser, tout en leur transmettant le plaisir de bouger.

  • Tu as l’intérêt et la possibilité de prendre en charge à l’avenir plusieurs cours par semaine, à différents jours de la semaine et/ou dans différents clubs.

  • Tu disposes de bonnes connaissances en allemand.

Ce que nous t’offrons :

  • Une équipe jeune, dynamique et internationale.

  • Une rémunération conforme aux standards du secteur.

  • Un accès gratuit à tous nos clubs de fitness.

Postule dès maintenant et rejoins la famille PureGym ! Ensemble, donnons à encore plus de personnes la possibilité de vivre une vie plus saine !

description: Location: fully remote, work from anywhere About what. AG what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. We build websites, e-commerce and growth marketing for Swiss SMEs — and we’re pushing hard into AI-driven delivery, from our own Support Agent to our what. growth product. We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts. About the role Support has grown into one of our core services — service-agreement clients, our AI Support Agent, and on-demand project management. We’re looking for one person to own it end-to-end: the vision, the processes, the quality, the team and the commercials — and to push how far we can take AI in support. You turn a growing, multi-part operation into one well-led, measurable, continuously improving service. How we work You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class support to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we’re AI-first: we automate the repetitive parts and use AI as a core tool every day, so the team can focus on judgement and quality. What you’ll do Own Support end-to-end — set the vision, priorities and best practices, and give the function clear direction. Run and level up our processes and AI — continuously improve all support processes, including our AI Support Agent; keep them documented, train the team, own security & compliance. Lead the team — empower Support Managers, WordPress developers, the on-demand PM and specialists; strong ticket and incident management and a culture of continuous learning. Drive quality and delivery — define and track SA quality and delivery metrics (client satisfaction, return rate, response and completion times) and report to management. Be a trusted partner to key SA clients — foster up- and cross-selling and act as relationship manager; you think about their business, not just their tickets. Keep an eye on budget and profitability — invoicing, contribution margin and cost-saving measures, with support from our finance team. Handle continuity and crises — prepare for and manage outages and security incidents calmly. Key & Essential Skills Ideally 5+ years in support, service delivery or technical account management (digital/web agency or hosting/WordPress environment), including experience leading a small team. Solid technical grasp of WordPress, hosting and uptime/security monitoring — you don’t code, but you speak the language and can steer technical work. A strong process thinker genuinely excited to take our use of AI in support to the next level. Commercial sense — comfortable with invoicing, budgets and contribution margin. Native Language German and Fluent English (our working language) is required Comfortable with written-only communication (tickets, email, chat); this role has no phone support. What makes you a fit You take ownership and see things through. You stay calm and structured under pressure — incidents and outages don’t rattle you. You give honest feedback, to clients and to us. You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward. Perks Fully remote — work from anywhere. (Our Seefeld office in Zurich is there if you’re local.) Real responsibility and influence — and a team that has your back. See something to improve? Speak up, we’re listening. Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy — results-oriented, no micromanaging. A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools like Claude. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Fair compensation and profit participation. Personal development opportunities — e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins’ UPW event. How to Apply Apply via our website with your CV and a short intro video (2–3 min, in German or English — whichever you’re most comfortable in; e.g. Loom or YouTube): tell us what drew you to this role and share an example where you improved a support operation or led a team through a tough incident. 👉 Applications without a video or sent via other channels (e.g. email or social media) won’t be considered. raw.title: Head of Support (m/f/d) – Fully Remote
raw.description:
Location: fully remote, work from anywhere

About what. AG

what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. We build websites, e-commerce and growth marketing for Swiss SMEs — and we’re pushing hard into AI-driven delivery, from our own Support Agent to our what. growth product. We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts.

About the role

Support has grown into one of our core services — service-agreement clients, our AI Support Agent, and on-demand project management. We’re looking for one person to own it end-to-end: the vision, the processes, the quality, the team and the commercials — and to push how far we can take AI in support. You turn a growing, multi-part operation into one well-led, measurable, continuously improving service.

How we work

You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class support to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we’re AI-first: we automate the repetitive parts and use AI as a core tool every day, so the team can focus on judgement and quality.


What you’ll do

  • Own Support end-to-end — set the vision, priorities and best practices, and give the function clear direction.

  • Run and level up our processes and AI — continuously improve all support processes, including our AI Support Agent; keep them documented, train the team, own security & compliance.

  • Lead the team — empower Support Managers, WordPress developers, the on-demand PM and specialists; strong ticket and incident management and a culture of continuous learning.

  • Drive quality and delivery — define and track SA quality and delivery metrics (client satisfaction, return rate, response and completion times) and report to management.

  • Be a trusted partner to key SA clients — foster up- and cross-selling and act as relationship manager; you think about their business, not just their tickets.

  • Keep an eye on budget and profitability — invoicing, contribution margin and cost-saving measures, with support from our finance team.

  • Handle continuity and crises — prepare for and manage outages and security incidents calmly.

Key & Essential Skills

  • Ideally 5+ years in support, service delivery or technical account management (digital/web agency or hosting/WordPress environment), including experience leading a small team.

  • Solid technical grasp of WordPress, hosting and uptime/security monitoring — you don’t code, but you speak the language and can steer technical work.

  • A strong process thinker genuinely excited to take our use of AI in support to the next level.

  • Commercial sense — comfortable with invoicing, budgets and contribution margin.

  • Native Language German and Fluent English (our working language) is required

  • Comfortable with written-only communication (tickets, email, chat); this role has no phone support.

What makes you a fit

  • You take ownership and see things through.

  • You stay calm and structured under pressure — incidents and outages don’t rattle you.

  • You give honest feedback, to clients and to us.

  • You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward.

Perks

  • Fully remote — work from anywhere. (Our Seefeld office in Zurich is there if you’re local.)

  • Real responsibility and influence — and a team that has your back. See something to improve? Speak up, we’re listening.

  • Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy — results-oriented, no micromanaging.

  • A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools like Claude.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays.

  • Fair compensation and profit participation.

  • Personal development opportunities — e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins’ UPW event.

How to Apply

  • Apply via our website with your CV and a short intro video (2–3 min, in German or English — whichever you’re most comfortable in; e.g. Loom or YouTube): tell us what drew you to this role and share an example where you improved a support operation or led a team through a tough incident.

  • 👉 Applications without a video or sent via other channels (e.g. email or social media) won’t be considered.

title: Intelligence Development Specialist - CHF (m/w/d)
description: Über Foreus FOREUS ist ein international ausgerichtetes Private Intelligence Unternehmen, das nachrichtendienstliche Methoden, technologische Innovation und strategische Informationsbeschaffung miteinander verbindet. Mit unserem Standort in Luzern und der Foreus Swiss Intelligence GmbH bauen wir unsere Präsenz auf dem Schweizer Markt gezielt aus. Unser Anspruch ist es, Private Intelligence als unverzichtbare strategische Ressource für Unternehmen, Finanzinstitutionen, Rechtsanwaltskanzleien und institutionelle Entscheidungsträger zu etablieren. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die wirtschaftliches Verständnis, nachrichtendienstliches Denken und strategische Netzwerkentwicklung miteinander verbindet. Du sollst nicht einfach einen Markt betreuen. Du sollst ihn mitentwickeln. Deine Aufgaben Strategischer Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der FOREUS-Präsenz auf dem Schweizer Markt. Identifikation neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Bereich Private Intelligence, Investigations und Intelligence Technologies. Aufbau und Pflege eines strategischen Netzwerks zu Entscheidungsträgern aus Wirtschaft, Finanzwesen, Rechtswesen und institutionellem Umfeld. Eigenständige Identifikation und Ansprache potenzieller Mandanten und strategischer Kooperationspartner. Entwicklung langfristiger Geschäftsbeziehungen zu Banken, Versicherungen, Family Offices, Rechtsanwaltskanzleien und international tätigen Unternehmen. Identifikation und Analyse von Marktpotenzialen, Wettbewerbsstrukturen und sicherheitsrelevanten Entwicklungen. Präsentation des gesamten FOREUS-Leistungsportfolios sowie unserer Intelligence-Technologien. Erfassung und Bewertung komplexer Mandantenanforderungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Intelligence Analysts und operativen Einheiten. Begleitung von Mandaten von der initialen Kontaktaufnahme bis zur Beauftragung. Entwicklung neuer Anwendungsbereiche für nachrichtendienstliche Dienstleistungen und technologische Lösungen. Aufbau strategischer Partnerschaften mit relevanten Schweizer Organisationen und Institutionen. Repräsentation von FOREUS bei Fachveranstaltungen, Konferenzen und exklusiven Netzwerkveranstaltungen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Management der FOREUS Group. Das bringst Du mit Wir suchen keine klassischen Vertriebsmitarbeiter. Wir suchen Persönlichkeiten, die Zusammenhänge erkennen, Vertrauen aufbauen, strategisch denken und sich souverän in anspruchsvollen wirtschaftlichen und institutionellen Strukturen bewegen können. Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Intelligence, Sicherheit, Consulting, Finanzwesen, Business Development oder vergleichbaren Tätigkeitsfeldern. Fundiertes Verständnis des Schweizer Wirtschafts- und Finanzmarktes. Ausgeprägtes Interesse an geopolitischen, wirtschaftlichen und sicherheitspolitischen Entwicklungen. Fähigkeit, komplexe Dienstleistungen und technologische Lösungen auf Entscheidungsträgerebene zu vermitteln. Bestehendes Netzwerk innerhalb der Schweizer Wirtschaft oder institutioneller Strukturen von Vorteil. Ausgeprägtes Verhandlungsgeschick und souveränes Auftreten. Unternehmerisches Denken und ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative. Fähigkeit, sensible Sachverhalte zu verstehen und professionell zu kommunizieren. Absolute Diskretion, persönliche Integrität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Französisch oder Italienisch von Vorteil. Bereitschaft zu nationaler und internationaler Reisetätigkeit. Besonders interessant sind für uns berufliche Hintergründe in folgenden Bereichen: Nachrichtendienste und Sicherheitsbehörden Militär und militärisches Nachrichtenwesen Private Banking & Wealth Management Corporate Intelligence Corporate Security Financial Crime & Compliance Strategic Consulting Diplomatie und internationale Organisationen Risk Management Investigations & Due Diligence Vergütung Die monatliche Vergütung für diese Position liegt bei CHF 6,000–8,000. title: Senior Research Scientist 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.</span></p></div><h2>Role</h2> <p>As a Senior 3D Reconstruction &amp; Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate.&nbsp;</p> <h2>How your work moves the mission forward</h2> <ul> <li>Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models</li> <li>Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)</li> <li>Ground high-level semantic concepts into 3D geometric structures. This means building queryable, object-centric 3D scene graphs that map not just where an object is, but what it is, and its relationship to the other objects, and its functional properties</li> <li>Integrate open-vocabulary vision language models (ex: CLiP based visual descriptors, DINOv2) into 3D metric space to allow the robot to reason about natural language instructions (ex: ‘pick up the half-eaten apple and put it in the trash bin’)</li> <li>Develop learning-based spatial models (such as 3D Diffusion Policies) that utilize 3D point clouds to predict continuous grasp poses and trajectories</li> <li>Translate abstract semantic logic into functional affordances (ex: identifying the ‘graspable’ part of a mug versus the ‘containment’ part)</li> <li>Collaborate with eng teams to ensure that stochastic, learned semantic models cleanly map to deterministic safe boundaries on physical hardware</li> <li>Drive data strategies for collecting, labeling, and generating 3D synthetic data&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>Skills you will need to be successful</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> PhD (preferred) or Master’s in Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field—with a focus on Spatial AI, SLAM, or Embodied AI .</li> <li><strong>3D Vision:</strong> Deep mathematical foundations in multi-view geometry, camera calibration, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and probabilistic state estimation .</li> <li><strong>Modern Deep Learning:</strong> Proven experience training and deploying multimodal architectures (VLMs/VLAs), contrastive learning frameworks, or 3D neural scene representations (NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting)</li> <li><strong>Programming &amp; Systems</strong>: Expert level command of Python (PyTorch)</li> </ul> <h2>Skills that will differentiate your candidacy</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with robotics middleware (ROS2) and real time execution constraints would be a plus</li> <li>Hands-on "battle scars" from deploying onto physical robotic manipulators or mobile platforms</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Intrinsic, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment at Intrinsic is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Intrinsic does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. It is Intrinsic’s policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.</p> <p>If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at: ----- Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Director - Corporate, Issues & Crisis
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Director within our Corporate, Issues &amp; Crisis team, you will be a senior strategic advisor and team leader – protecting and enhancing the reputations of some of the world’s most significant organisations. Based in Amsterdam, you’ll lead high-stakes issues and crisis work across the Energy &amp; Industrials, Healthcare or Technology sectors, counselling senior clients through their most sensitive moments and delivering media training that builds their confidence and capability. You’ll grow existing relationships, win new business, and help build the visibility, reputation and talent of the team in the Netherlands.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take a leading role in developing Burson’s corporate, issues and crisis work in the Netherlands – retaining existing clients and growing new business</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor and senior counsel to clients, adding strategic value during sensitive, high-stakes and reputational moments</li> <li>Lead issues and crisis programmes for clients across the Energy &amp; Industrials, Healthcare or Technology sectors, anticipating risks and building proactive response plans</li> <li>Design and deliver media training and crisis simulation exercises that build client confidence and capability</li> <li>Build the visibility and reputation of the team – with a view to winning new business and attracting talent</li> <li>Manage and mentor client teams, nurturing talent and contributing to a strong, collaborative team culture across the agency</li> <li>Take responsibility for budget monitoring, revenue forecasting, resourcing and fee negotiation to ensure the correct level of profitability</li> <li>Represent Burson externally in relevant specialist forums, network groups and speaker platforms across the Dutch and EU market</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven background leading corporate, issues and crisis management within both agency and in-house settings, with strong exposure to complex, high-stakes scenarios and strategic media relations.</li> <li>Sector expertise across either Energy &amp; Industrials, Healthcare or Technology with a strong understanding of the issues shaping these industries</li> <li>Experienced in designing and delivering media training and crisis simulation exercises, alongside wider reputation management initiatives</li> <li>Skilled in managing communications across a broad range of stakeholders – including media, government, employees, investors and consumers – during sensitive, high-pressure moments</li> <li>Commercially driven and entrepreneurial, with a track record of independently identifying and converting new business and managing client relationships end-to-end</li> <li>Trusted advisor to senior communications leaders and C-suite executives, with excellent interpersonal skills and credibility at the highest levels</li> <li>A strong, collaborative team leader, experienced in resourcing, commercial oversight and building high-performing, resilient teams, with previous experience within both agency and client-side environments.</li> <li>Full professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with the confidence to counsel clients and present in both languages</li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-RE1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our &nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

in internal and external project team meetings&nbsp;</li> <li>Write and review governing procedure (e.g., SOPs, WIs, etc.), where necessary&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Other duties as assigned&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You’ll Work&nbsp;</u></strong></h3> <p>This is a Netherlands-based role that will require 30% travel.</p> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience leading agencies and collaborating across commercial and international teams. van ervaring, leeftijd en senioriteit.</li> <li><strong>Flexibiliteit:</strong>&nbsp;Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU).</li> <li><strong>Vrijheid: </strong>Veel eigen verantwoordelijk om je eigen rol en werkdag in te vullen.</li> <li><strong>Werkomgeving: </strong>werken in een goed georganiseerde creatieve omgeving met een enthousiast team van creatieven, projectmanagers en mediaspecialisten.</li> <li><strong>Klanten:</strong> Werken voor A merken van Nederland en internationaal op projecten waar je écht trots op kunt zijn en die zichtbaar impact maken.</li> <li><strong>Groeikansen</strong>:&nbsp;Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team, met een focus op AI-transformatie.</li> <li><strong>Toegang tot M Academy:</strong>&nbsp;Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel&nbsp;hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.</li> <li><strong>Reiskostenvergoeding:</strong>&nbsp;Reiskosten worden volledig vergoed.</li> <li><strong>8% vakantiegeld&nbsp;en&nbsp;26 vakantiedagen&nbsp;per jaar</strong> (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).</li> <li><strong>Hybrid Working allowance:</strong>&nbsp;<strong>€30 netto</strong> per maand bij fulltime.</li> <li><strong>Bring Your Own Device (BYOD):</strong>&nbsp;Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van <strong>€57,50 netto</strong>.</li> <li><strong>Lunchfaciliteiten:</strong>&nbsp;Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie.</li> <li><strong>Zorgverzekering:</strong>&nbsp;Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering<strong>.</strong></li> </ul> <p>Geen dag is hier hetzelfde! Het ene moment duik je in een briefing met een klant, het volgende moment ben je met een creative bezig om een campagne pixel-perfect te krijgen. Je werkt met verschillende disciplines, klanten en uitdagingen, waardoor je continu leert en groeit. En jij bent degene die ervoor zorgt dat alles klopt.</p> <p>Enthousiast? title: Senior AI Solution Specialist
description: Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions? As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself. You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security. This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed. Location:  Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office) Start Date:  January/February 2027 Availability : Fulltime Your impact Lead complex AI discovery Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype. Build AI solutions yourself Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it. Shape enterprise AI initiatives Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful. Design for production Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value. Create reusable AI patterns Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities. Coach and challenge others Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself. Strengthen responsible AI Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives. Who you are You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way. Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. You may have led technical initiatives, defined architecture or coached others, but you haven’t moved away from building things yourself, and you don’t want to. What you bring Must-haves A proven track record of delivering complex AI, automation, integration, data or cloud solutions Strong solution design skills across applications, APIs, identity, data, integrations and cloud services Experience taking ambiguous business problems from discovery through prototyping, testing and solution design Experience defining architecture options, non-functional requirements and production readiness The ability to translate between business needs and technical possibilities Confidence working with business leaders, architects, product owners and engineers Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to review, challenge and coach others without stepping away from hands-on delivery Nice-to-haves Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search and enterprise knowledge solutions Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, connectors and/or MCP Development or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or PowerShell Experience working with AI agents, assistants or orchestration workflows Experience in the travel or tourism industry Our technology Our AI and technology landscape includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, MCP, Entra ID and Git. Let us introduce Sunweb Group   Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.    Why join our journey? Monthly gross salary between €6500,- and €8000,- plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance). Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts. Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.   As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment.  We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment.  Access to LinkedIn Learning and a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.   Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.   Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.   Ready for departure?  Do you want to become part of our team as Senior AI Solution Specialist? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you! Closing date for applications: 5 December Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.    As part of our recruitment process, we use AI-supported tools to assist recruiters in matching candidates to job requirements.
