raw.description:
Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions?

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/February 2027

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery
    Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Build AI solutions yourself
    Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives
    Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Design for production
    Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

  • Create reusable AI patterns
    Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities.

  • Coach and challenge others
    Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

  • Strengthen responsible AI
    Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

Who you are

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. You may have led technical initiatives, defined architecture or coached others, but you haven’t moved away from building things yourself, and you don’t want to.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • A proven track record of delivering complex AI, automation, integration, data or cloud solutions

  • Strong solution design skills across applications, APIs, identity, data, integrations and cloud services

  • Experience taking ambiguous business problems from discovery through prototyping, testing and solution design

  • Experience defining architecture options, non-functional requirements and production readiness

  • The ability to translate between business needs and technical possibilities

  • Confidence working with business leaders, architects, product owners and engineers

  • Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to review, challenge and coach others without stepping away from hands-on delivery

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search and enterprise knowledge solutions

  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, connectors and/or MCP

  • Development or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or PowerShell

  • Experience working with AI agents, assistants or orchestration workflows

  • Experience in the travel or tourism industry

Our technology

Our AI and technology landscape includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, MCP, Entra ID and Git.

Let us introduce Sunweb Group  

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.   

Why join our journey?

  • Monthly gross salary between €6500,- and €8000,- plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance). Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts.

  • Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.  

  • As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment. 

  • We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment. 

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning and a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.  

  • Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.  

  • Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.  

Ready for departure? 

Do you want to become part of our team as Senior AI Solution Specialist? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Closing date for applications: 5 December

Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.  

As part of our recruitment process, we use AI-supported tools to assist recruiters in matching candidates to job requirements. Final hiring decisions are always made by human recruiters.

title: Software Engineer (Python & Cloud)
description: Build the software behind large-scale battery storage Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels. But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on. About GIGA Storage Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously. We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance. Your role You develop and grow our Giga platform. You build software in Python, working with technologies including SQL, Terraform, Grafana and data processing. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism. What will you work on? When a new battery site goes live, data on capacity, performance and equipment status needs to flow reliably into our platform. You build the software and integrations that make this happen. At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. You can propose tools and improvements; important technical decisions are made together with the team and our IT Lead. What will you do? Build software. Develop and maintain Python services and integrations for new battery sites. Make data reliable. Build and improve data pipelines, quality checks and monitoring. Work smarter. Automate repeatable tasks and improve documentation, standards and maintainability, using AI tools where useful. Own what you build. Test, deploy and support your software, and discuss technical improvements with the team. Add knowledge, creativity and fun to the IT team. What do you bring? Higher professional education (HBO) level of thinking and working, and at least four years of relevant software development experience. Python experience; one year may be sufficient if you have also programmed in other languages. Experience with at least one cloud platform: GCP, AWS or Azure. Interest in data engineering and DevOps; Terraform, SQL and CI/CD knowledge is a plus. A broad technical mindset, ownership and a willingness to automate, document and share knowledge. Good English communication skills and availability to work from our Amsterdam office at least three days a week. Energy-sector experience and Dutch language skills are not required. Why join GIGA Storage? Visible impact. Your software helps bring new battery sites into operation. Technical variety. Combine software, data and cloud while broadening your skills. Room to contribute. Help automate our platform and prepare it for the next stage of growth. Build together. Join five international IT colleagues in our new Buitenveldert office, close to Amsterdam Zuid. What do we offer? A competitive salary plus holiday allowance (8%) A fixed year-end bonus (7-9%) and performance-related bonus (max 10%). 28 days of annual leave for full-time employment A pension plan. A €750 annual learning budget, laptop, phone allowance and e-bike scheme. Hybrid working: at least three days a week in our Amsterdam office; choose home or office for the remaining days. Healthy lunches and occasional fun activities Ready to build with us? Want to develop software that matters while working on the energy transition? Apply through our website. We look forward to meeting you! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

En wil je samen met collega’s bouwen aan een verantwoorde balans tussen informatiebeveiliging, privacy en het benutten van kansen die de snelle ontwikkeling in automatisering en AI bieden? Dan zoeken wij jou. Dit ga je doen Als Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy zorg je ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot niet alleen goed zijn geregeld op papier, maar vooral ook in de praktijk. Je vertaalt beleid, risico’s en wet- en regelgeving naar concrete maatregelen en helpt collega’s om deze toe te passen. Je werkt nauw samen met de Information Security & Privacy Officer (ISO/PO), de Functionaris Gegevensbescherming (FG), IT en verschillende teams binnen Berenschot. Vanuit jouw rol houd je overzicht, coördineer je verbeteracties en steek je zelf de handen uit de mouwen. Je bent dus niet alleen adviserend bezig, maar zorgt er ook voor dat zaken daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd. Je bevordert het bewustzijn en de kennis van informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen de organisatie en ondersteunt bij incidenten, risicoanalyses en assessments. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van het informatiebeveiligings- en privacybeleid en de vertaling hiervan naar praktische afspraken en acties. Periodiek rapporteren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy aan de directie en het management, met concrete aandachtspunten en voorstellen voor verbetering. Het signaleren en beoordelen van risico’s en het uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en DPIA’s samen met collega’s. Het onderhouden en verder verbeteren van het Information Security Management System (ISMS) en daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van onder andere de AVG, NIS2 en ISO 27001. Het coördineren van verbeteracties en ondersteunen bij informatiebeveiligingsincidenten en datalekken. Het vergroten van bewustzijn binnen de organisatie en collega’s praktisch adviseren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy. De rol biedt nadrukkelijk ruimte om te groeien. Naarmate je de organisatie en het vakgebied beter leert kennen, pak je steeds meer regie en ontwikkel je je verder van een praktisch en coördinerende rol naar een meer tactische en strategische adviesrol. Het vermogen om risico’s en beleid te vertalen naar concrete, werkbare maatregelen en acties. Een praktische en zelfstandige houding: je adviseert, organiseert én pakt zelf zaken op. Berenschot is een platte organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar echt naar je geluisterd wordt. Als Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy zorg je ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot niet alleen goed zijn geregeld op papier, maar vooral ook in de praktijk. Je bevordert het bewustzijn en de kennis van informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen de organisatie en ondersteunt bij incidenten, risicoanalyses en assessments.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het signaleren en beoordelen van risico’s en het uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en DPIA’s samen met collega’s.

  • Het onderhouden en verder verbeteren van het Information Security Management System (ISMS) en daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van onder andere de AVG, NIS2 en ISO 27001.

  • Het coördineren van verbeteracties en ondersteunen bij informatiebeveiligingsincidenten en datalekken.

  • Het vergroten van bewustzijn binnen de organisatie en collega’s praktisch adviseren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy.

  • De rol biedt nadrukkelijk ruimte om te groeien. Naarmate je de organisatie en het vakgebied beter leert kennen, pak je steeds meer regie en ontwikkel je je verder van een praktisch en coördinerende rol naar een meer tactische en strategische adviesrol.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Je hebt een stevige basis in informatiebeveiliging en privacy en vindt het leuk om zaken daadwerkelijk voor elkaar te krijgen. In 2026 heeft O&P Rijk de financiële functie laten doorlichten. Deze doorlichting geeft richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling van financiële processen, rapportages, interne beheersing en de inrichting van de organisatie. title: Data Analyst - Logistics
description: Maybe you call yourself a Data Specialist, a BI Consultant, a "why-does-this-number-not-match-their-Excel" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself: we're bringing a whole group of container terminals onto one data platform, and you will help us do that in the best way by getting to know how the container terminals work and how their data is shaped. Over time, you'll become the person everyone turns to when they need to understand a terminal and its data. What you get  A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience.  €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.  25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.  Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.  €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.  A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then.  Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We will consider remote candidates too. We use salary zones, so the range may be lower elsewhere in Europe. If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands, the salary range will be shared before your first interview. Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.  About us  All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities.    What the job looks like  Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems. Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team. Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source. Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal. Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history. What you bring  Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told. Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too. Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job. Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time. Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge . You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards. AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do. Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus. Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus. Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.   We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.  Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Senior Growth Marketer, Web & Experimentation
raw.description:
Our Growth Marketers bring buyers to datasnipper.com through integrated campaigns. You'll turn that traffic into demo requests and pipeline. You'll run A/B tests, personalize the site, work on conversion rate optimization (CRO), and manage the projects that add new functionality to our websites. You'll also bring AI into the website program, building on the AI that already runs our go-to-market.

You'll work from one ranked backlog and report each week on what moved conversion. You'll form hypotheses from data, get them built with our designer and developer, and roll out the winners.

Your closest partners are the Growth Marketers, our Senior Web Experience Designer and Senior Web Developer, and GTM Engineering, which collects intent data from our website.

About DataSnipper

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

Where the website stands today

Most of our inbound pipeline starts on datasnipper.com. Until now, our Senior Growth Marketer handled CRO on the side, and many people on the Marketing team publish pages, update content individually. In short, very fragmented collaboration.

In an AI-dense market, that work counts for more. Anyone can generate volume now. What's hard, and what earns attention, is staying close to what our customers care about and bringing campaign ideas sharp enough to cut through. That's the work that sets this team apart, and what you'll be part of.

Our tracking needs a cleanup before we can trust test results. Localized landing pages come next: Japan, DACH and France need web experiences in their own language. GTM Engineering already scores visitor intent by page, and we barely use that data on the site. Personalization by segment and market has barely started.

AI already runs parts of our go-to-market. Agents nurture leads, a classifier scores the intent behind every web visit, and we enrich accounts automatically. The website hasn't caught up.

Buyers also find us in new ways. More of them research software through ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews before they ever reach our site.

The web team has a dedicated designer and developer. This role decides what we test next and reports what worked.

What you'll be doing

Run the experimentation program

  • Build the testing roadmap for datasnipper.com and the localized sites, from hypothesis to rollout.

  • Set the website's testing rules: minimum sample size, test duration, and when to call or stop a test.

  • Keep a learning log that Growth, Sales and Product Marketing check before they propose a test.

  • Report results in pipeline terms: demo requests, demo-to-SQL rate and pipeline per session.

Improve conversion where buyers decide

  • Optimize the demo request flow and the pricing, product and campaign pages.

  • Map the funnel from first visit to SQL in GA4 and HubSpot, find where buyers drop off, and fix it.

  • Work with the Growth Marketers to match each campaign landing page to its ad, audience and market.

Personalize the site

  • Tailor content, proof points and CTAs by vertical, market and buying stage.

  • Use intent and enrichment data from GTM Engineering to decide who sees what.

  • Test each localized site as it launches, to the same standard as the English site.

Build AI into the web program

  • Use the intent and enrichment data we already collect to build pages that adapt to each visitor.

  • Use AI to generate and localize test variants, so we test more ideas each month.

  • Automate test QA, result analysis and weekly reporting, with a person signing off on the results.

  • Prototype new AI experiences for buyers, such as an assistant that answers product and pricing questions.

Manage web projects

  • Scope new website functionality, write the brief, and run delivery with our designer and developer.

  • Turn requests from Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and Growth into a ranked backlog, and use data to decide what waits.

  • Run QA and launch, then measure each project's result.

Keep the site findable and measurable

  • Protect organic search and AI visibility in every test and launch: canonicals, page speed, schema markup and crawl access.

  • Track traffic and demo requests referred by AI assistants, and test pages for buyers who arrive that way.

  • Maintain website tracking with Marketing Operations in Google Tag Manager, GA4 and HubSpot.

  • Build the weekly web performance view the team works from.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in CRO, web optimization or growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS. You've run an A/B testing program and can walk us through tests that won and tests that lost.

  • Data fluency. You know when to trust a test result, and when sample size, novelty or segment noise undermine it. You pull your own numbers from GA4 and HubSpot.

  • Structure. You run a backlog, write briefs a developer can build from, and keep several projects moving. You tell stakeholders each week what ships.

  • Collaboration. You get work done through a designer, a developer and stakeholders who all want space on the website. You involve them before you set a hypothesis, and use data to settle priority disputes.

  • AI builder. You’ve shipped something with AI that changed how a team works: an agent, an automated workflow, or a tool other people use. Bring the example and what broke first.

  • Commercial focus. You judge tests on the pipeline they create.

Tools you'll work with (willingness to ramp & learn matters more than a complete checklist):

  • Creative: Figma, Canva

  • Website: Framer, Contentstack

  • Analytics: HubSpot, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, Fibbler, Snowflake

  • CRM and marketing automation: HubSpot

  • Experimentation and personalization: Optimizely

  • Behavior analytics: heatmaps and session recordings

  • Project management and handoff: Linear, Figma

  • AI: Claude Enterprise (Projects, Skills and MCP integrations), ChatGPT, and build tools such as Lovable or n8n

Bonus: hands-on technical SEO and a view on how AI search changes the way buyers find B2B software. SQL, or enough HTML, CSS and JavaScript to set up a test yourself.

description: About us Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference. This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. What we are looking for 3+ years driving scaled adoption or retention for a large customer base, for example in scaled or digital Customer Success, CS or Revenue Operations, lifecycle or CRM marketing, or growth, at a SaaS or subscription business. Proven experience turning product usage data into health scores, signals or lifecycle triggers. A track record of one-to-many programs with results you can show in numbers, including how you knew the change came from the program and not something else. No need to wait for an admin: you build workflows and sequences yourself in tools like HubSpot, or Chameleon. Solid SQL skills: you write and read it independently. Nice to haves You’ve built a CS program or function from scratch (0 to 1), not only taken one over. Hands-on work with agent specs or AI-supported workflows in a CS or support setting, and using AI daily for writing, analysis and testing while knowing its limits: wrong answers, privacy, and when a person has to step in. A background in the live event, AV or equipment rental industry. title: Principal AI & Automation Lead
description: AI speelt een steeds grotere rol in hoe we onze producten verbeteren, klanten ondersteunen en interne processen slimmer inrichten. Maar de échte waarde van AI zit wat ons betreft niet in de technologie zelf, maar in wat we ermee kunnen bereiken. Als onze AI & Automation Lead ontdek je waar AI het verschil kan maken. Je gaat met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen in gesprek, luistert naar hun ervaringen en uitdagingen en vertaalt ideeën en behoeften naar praktische oplossingen. Dat doe je niet alleen achter je eigen scherm. Je organiseert workshops, helpt collega's met verschillende niveaus van technische kennis op weg met AI, experimenteert met nieuwe technologie en bouwt zelf prototypes en automatiseringen. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om kansen te ontdekken, prioriteiten te stellen en initiatieven van idee tot implementatie te begeleiden. Daarmee maak je niet alleen het werk van je collega's makkelijker en leuker, maar draag je ook bij aan betere producten en dienstverlening voor onze 270.000 klanten. Wie zijn wij? Mijndomein is een van de grootste en laatste onafhankelijke hostingproviders van Nederland. Omdat we volledig in privébezit zijn, groeien we op onze eigen manier: wendbaar, klantgericht en met een langetermijnvisie. We nemen beslissingen met het belang van onze klanten én het bedrijf voor ogen. Inmiddels vertrouwen 270.000 klanten op onze diensten en beheren we meer dan 1 miljoen domeinnamen. En omdat we geloven in samen bouwen, kunnen medewerkers via onze participatieregeling mede-eigenaar worden van de organisatie en zo meedelen in de waarde die we samen creëren. Mijndomein is onderdeel van The Sharing Group, actief binnen Online, Mobiliteit en Energie Wat ga je doen? Als AI & Automation Lead speel je een belangrijke rol bij het inzetten van AI binnen Mijndomein. Je houdt je bezig met interne bedrijfsprocessen én toepassingen die onze producten en dienstverlening verbeteren. Concreet betekent dit dat je: Kansen ontdekt en prioriteiten stelt: je brengt ons huidige AI-gebruik in kaart, ontdekt verbeterkansen en bepaalt samen met collega's welke initiatieven de meeste waarde opleveren. Processen automatiseert: je ontwikkelt praktische automatiseringen en AI-workflows die repetitief werk verminderen en collega's tijd besparen. Collega's verder helpt: je organiseert toegankelijke trainingen en workshops, ondersteunt collega's bij het gebruik van AI en deelt succesvolle toepassingen tussen afdelingen. Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers. Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's. Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid. Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven. Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt. We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen. Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken. Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften. Hoe je jouw kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je ermee kunt bereiken. Of je nu een technische opleiding hebt gevolgd, jezelf veel hebt aangeleerd of vanuit een ander vakgebied in AI en automatisering bent terechtgekomen: we zijn benieuwd naar wat jij meebrengt. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring met het implementeren van AI-oplossingen, automatiseringen of vergelijkbare technologische verbeteringen binnen organisaties. De technische kennis om zelfstandig prototypes, AI-workflows en automatiseringen te ontwikkelen. Kennis van API's, integraties en moderne AI-tools, en inzicht in hoe je verschillende systemen met elkaar kunt laten samenwerken. Het vermogen om zelfstandig projecten te begeleiden, prioriteiten te stellen en onderscheid te maken tussen interessante experimenten en waardevolle oplossingen. Het vermogen om technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen en collega's te ondersteunen bij veranderingen. Oog voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging en verantwoord gebruik van AI, waaronder mogelijke vooroordelen en risico's van AI-toepassingen. Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van toepassingen rondom LLM's, AI-agents of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Een nieuwsgierige, praktische en resultaatgerichte aanpak, waarbij je openstaat voor feedback en verschillende perspectieven. Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: Ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python of JavaScript. Ervaring met automatiseringsplatformen zoals n8n, Make of vergelijkbare tools. Ervaring met het organiseren van workshops, trainingen of interne kennissessies. Affiniteit met hosting, SaaS of andere technische dienstverlening. Herken je jezelf in deze rol, maar voldoe je niet aan alle punten? Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We kijken graag naar jouw kennis, ervaring, potentieel en motivatie. Wat bieden wij? Stick Together, Own It & Be Bold. Dat zijn onze kernwaarden en die zie je terug in hoe we samenwerken. Bij Mijndomein krijg je de vrijheid om ideeën niet alleen aan te dragen, maar ook daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. We helpen elkaar, geven ruimte aan verschillende perspectieven en waarderen initiatief, constructieve feedback en de bereidheid om te experimenteren en te leren. We geloven dat verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en manieren van denken ons als organisatie sterker maken. We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, zich gehoord voelt en de ruimte krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen. We zijn goed ingericht op hybride werken, maar vinden het ook belangrijk om elkaar regelmatig te ontmoeten. Daarom werk je minimaal twee dagen per week op ons kantoor in Almere, op dinsdag en donderdag . Regelmatig komt daar ook de maandag bij, waardoor je vaak drie dagen per week op kantoor bent. Daarnaast bieden we: Een passend salaris, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Internet-, telefonie- en thuiswerkvergoeding. €750 per jaar voor boeken, workshops, seminars of andere dingen die bijdragen aan jouw ontwikkeling. Een aanvullend studiebudget van €2.500 per jaar . Een vast aantal studie-uren per jaar, zodat je ook daadwerkelijk tijd kunt besteden aan je ontwikkeling. €550 voor het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek. Onze participatieregeling Good Shares , waarmee je mede-eigenaar kunt worden van de organisatie. Een pensioenbijdrage van 5,3% , volledig door ons betaald. Reiskostenvergoeding en een NS-Business Card. Ons kantoor zit pal naast station Almere Centraal. En verschillende extra's, zoals stoelmassages, vers bereide (warme) lunches op kantoor en korting op je sportabonnement. Enthousiast? Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van mogelijkheden, het bouwen van slimme oplossingen en het helpen van anderen om technologie écht te benutten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke verbeteringen je hebt gerealiseerd, wat je onderweg hebt geleerd en hoe jij AI binnen een organisatie als Mijndomein zou aanpakken. Dat mag vanuit je werkervaring zijn, maar ook vanuit eigen projecten of andere initiatieven. Bij ons is iedereen welkom om te solliciteren, ongeacht achtergrond, leeftijd, gender, identiteit of persoonlijke omstandigheden. Heb je tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure bepaalde ondersteuning of aanpassingen nodig? Laat het ons gerust weten, dan kijken we samen naar de mogelijkheden. title: Stage of afstuderen Finance: Memoriaal Boekingen
description: Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze stageopdracht duik je in het maandafsluitingsproces en verder optimalisering en automatisering hiervan. Je onderzoekt welke memoriaalboekingen er worden gemaakt, waarom ze ontstaan en hoeveel tijd ze kosten. Daarmee help je Finance om de doorlooptijd van de maandafsluiting te verkorten en het proces minder foutgevoelig te maken. Wat je gaat doen: Inventariseren van alle memoriaal boekingen binnen het maandafsluitingsproces / analyseren van historische data; Categoriseren van memoriaal boekingen (bijvoorbeeld correcties, accruals, reallocaties en eenmalige posten); In kaart brengen van de tijdsbesteding per type memoriaal boeking; Identificeren van oorzaken (procesmatig, datastructuur, systeembeperkingen, afhankelijkheden); Vaststellen welke memoriaal boekingen structureel, repeterend of te automatiseren zijn; Analyseren van de impact van memoriaal boekingen op doorlooptijd, foutgevoeligheid en controlelast. Uiteindelijk lever je een overzicht op van alle memoriaal boekingen met tijdsbesteding en frequentie inclusief een analyse en advies van de bottlenecks en verbetermogelijkheden. Aanbevelingen voor automatisering, toepassingen van AI, standaardisatie of eliminatie van memoriaal boekingen zijn een onderdeel van jouw advies. Wij vragen HBO of WO opleiding in de richting Finance & Control of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Strategist, Agent Development (Dutch speaking)
description: About us Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. What you'll do As an Agent Strategist , you own how Sierra's AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer's thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business. Own the Agent Development Life Cycle . Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it's the best version of itself in the real world. You'll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome. Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers' executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there. Partner with the customer's working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch. Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next. Example projects These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently: Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers. Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation. Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples. Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner. Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week. What you'll bring Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships. Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences. Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast. Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion. Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes. Even better... Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts. You've been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business. Our values Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud. Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality. Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard. Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time. Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship. What we offer We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees: Flexible (unlimited) paid time off Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family Life insurance and disability benefits Retirement plan dependent on country of employment Parental leave Fertility and family building benefits Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most Free alphorn lessons These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies. Be you, with us We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team.
